sources.cite: AWS Security Blog, How to automate incident response in the AWS Cloud for EC2 instances
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. The described order: capture the instance metadata to an S3 bucket before making changes; capture the console view; start snapshots of all EBS volumes; 'Set the Amazon EC2 termination protection flag on the instance'; detach the instance profile; if Systems Manager manages the instance, run OS-level gathering 'such as memory captures'; then 'Create a quarantine security group that lacks both ingress and egress rules' and move the instance into it; notify. The post does not cover Auto Scaling: that termination protection does not stop an Auto Scaling scale-in, and that standby or scale-in protection does, are from memory of the Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling user guide (to verify).
